verification_categories_derived_from_spe: Power-up + Initialization — VDD ramp + RESET# + 500 µs + CKE + tXPR + MRS(MR2, MR3, MR1, MR0 with DLL Reset) + ZQCL + tDLLK + tZQinit.
Reset-with-stable-power — RESET# LOW ≥ 100 ns; full init re-run.

All-state coverage of the simplified state diagram: Reset / Initialization / ZQ Calibration / Idle / Refreshing / Self-Refresh / MRS-MPR-WL / Activating / Bank Active / Reading / Writing / Reading+AP / Writing+AP / Precharging / Active-PD / Precharge-PD.
All-command coverage: MRS, REF, SRE, SRX, PRE, PREA, ACT, WR, WRS4, WRS8, WRA, WRAS4, WRAS8, RD, RDS4, RDS8, RDA, RDAS4, RDAS8, NOP, DES, PDE, PDX, ZQCL, ZQCS.
MR0 / MR1 / MR2 / MR3 field coverage — each field value plus reserved encoding rejection.
Burst length variants — BL8 fixed, BC4 fixed, BC4/BL8 on-the-fly via A12/BC#.
Burst order coverage — Sequential and Interleave (RBT) with all 8 starting column LSB patterns.
Latency coverage — CL = 5..11; CWL = 5..8; AL = 0, CL-1, CL-2; WR = 5..16.
Multi-bank interleave — 4-bank rolling within tFAW; tRRD between successive ACTs.
Refresh — average tREFI; up to 8 postponed / pulled-in; extra REF after SR exit; tRFC honoured.
Self-Refresh entry / exit — tCKESR, tCKSRE, tCKSRX, tXS, tXSDLL.
Power-Down variants — Active-PD (tXP), Precharge-PD Fast Exit (tXP), Precharge-PD Slow Exit (tXPDLL).
Clock frequency change — only in SR or Precharge-PD; new frequency stable before exit.
ZQ Calibration — ZQCL (tZQinit, tZQoper), ZQCS (tZQCS); single resistor and shared resistor scenarios.
Write Leveling — MR1 A7=1 entry / exit; DQ feedback sweep; multi-byte-lane independent leveling.
Read Leveling via MPR — MR3 A2=1 entry; predefined pattern read; sampling-phase sweep.
DLL on/off switching — MR1 A0; DLL-off only supports CL=6 and CWL=6; tCKDLL_OFF range.
On-Die Termination Synchronous Mode — ODTLon, ODTLoff timing per CWL + AL − 2.
On-Die Termination Dynamic Mode — Rtt_WR applied for 4 (BC4) or 8 (BL8) cycles around write burst.
On-Die Termination Asynchronous Mode — DLL-off; ODT pin direct control with tAON / tAOF.
tFAW — 4-bank activate power window enforcement.
Address / Command setup-hold — tIS, tIH at min/max slew (Sections 13.3 derating).
Data setup-hold — tDS, tDH at min/max slew (Section 13.4 derating).
Differential clock / DQS swing — AC ≥ 350 mV, Vix ±150 mV of VDD/2.
Single-ended VIH/VIL AC/DC compliance per Section 8.1.
Output driver Ron after ZQ calibration — ±10% target.
ODT Rtt under different MR1/MR2 settings.
IDD measurements at IDD0..IDD7 per Section 10.1 sequences.
PASR coverage — verify only the addressed bank-subset is refreshed and remaining cells lose content.
SRT / ASR coverage — refresh rate adjusts with MR2 A7/A6 across normal/extended temp range.
Test Mode rejection — MR0 A7=1 is vendor-reserved; user code must not set it.
Qoff coverage — MR1 A12=1 disables DQ/DQS output drivers; verify no leakage path.
TDQS coverage on x8 — MR1 A11=1 enables TDQS output; A11=0 enables DM input on shared pin.
Mode register access timing — tMRD between MRS, tMOD before non-MRS.
Refresh during Power-Down — verify PD does not refresh; SR does.
fields.notes: JESD79-3C does not include a formal verification plan or testbench; categories above are derived from Sections 3 (Functional Description), 4 (Command Description and Operation), 5 (ODT), 6-9 (Electrical), 10 (IDD), and 12-13 (AC Timing). The DDR3 SDRAM Component Compliance Test Plan is maintained separately by JEDEC and DRAM vendors (incl. JEDEC JESD224 for module-level testing); vendor DDR3 PHY IP also ships with its own verification suite.
